items.title: Texas Pacific Land to acquire EagleRock in $3bn transaction
items.summary: Land and royalty company Texas Pacific Land (NYSE: TPL) has struck a deal to acquire EagleRock Land (NYSE: EROK) in an all-stock deal that has an implied equity value of around $3bn. EagleRock is a land and water company that operates in the US’ prolific Permian Basin.

items.title: Texas Pacific Land's $3B EagleRock Deal Expands Permian Footprint
items.summary: TPL's $3 billion EROK deal is set to expand its Permian footprint, boost water solutions capacity and unlock stronger cash flow and shareholder returns.

items.title: What Does EagleRock Land (EROK) Merger Deal Mean For Shareholders?
items.summary: Texas Pacific Land Corporation agreed to acquire EagleRock Land (NYSE:EROK) in a merger valued at about US$620 million. The deal will create a new public holding company that will own both Texas Pacific Land Corporation and EagleRock Land. EagleRock Land shareholders are set to receive stock in the new parent entity, reshaping the ownership mix of the combined group.
